prompts.text: Explain, in detail, an experience you’ve had in the past 3 to 4 years related to your first-choice major. This can be an experience from an extracurricular activity, in a class you’ve taken, or through something else.
prompts.quote: Each essay should be about 150 words .

prompts.text: Describe your personal and/or career goals after graduating from Illinois and how your selected first-choice major will help you achieve them.
prompts.quote: Each essay should be about 150 words .

prompts.text: What are your future career or academic goals? You may include courses you took in high school and how these impacted your goals.
prompts.quote: Complete these prompts instead of the standard first-choice major essay prompts.

prompts.text: What are your academic interests? Please include 2-3 majors you’re considering at Illinois and why.

prompts.text: Please explain your interest in your second-choice major or your overall academic or career goals.
prompts.quote: When you apply with a second‑choice major, you’ll answer this additional prompt.

prompts.text: You’ll also pick one essay prompt from Common App’s list of prompts .
